title.narrative: Naryn Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Development Program

description.narrative: The ADB program will focus on RWSS provision for 42 villages in Naryn Oblast. The indicative program scope will include: (i) development and rehabilitation of water supply networks and related infrastructure; (ii) piloting of non-networked sanitation solutions; and (iii) establishment of sustainable operational models, including development of local capacity and community-based operational management.

description.narrative: Inclusive and reliable access to safe water supply and sanitation for rural communities in Naryn province improved
At least 100,000 people in the villages of Naryn province use potable water via climate- and disaster-resilient water infrastructure Achievement: 10000 Data Source: ARIS M&E systems

At least 16 village schools, 12 kindergartens, and 9 village health posts served by improved gender-sensitive and climate- and disaster-resilient water and sanitation facilities Data Source: ARIS M&E systems Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Climate-responsive water supply and sanitation infrastructure expanded and sanitation solutions piloted Indicator: Climate change risk assessments applied to all sites for potable water sources in the program by 2026 and become mandatory for the rural water supply services and rural sanitation subsector from 2024 Data Source: ARIS M&E systems Actual value:

Output: Climate-responsive water supply and sanitation infrastructure expanded and sanitation solutions piloted Indicator: Climate- and disaster-resilient infrastructure components for water supply and distribution networks in place for at least 100,000 people Data Source: ARIS M&E systems Actual value:

Output: Climate-responsive water supply and sanitation infrastructure expanded and sanitation solutions piloted Indicator: Non-networked climate- and disaster-resilient household sanitation solutions piloted in at least 4 villages with minimum combined total of 1,160 households Data Source: ARIS M&E systems Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacities strengthened for enhanced climate resilience and sustainability in the rural water supply services and sanitation subsector Indicator: 100% of internal audit staff and finance staff of ARIS trained and certified in internal audit and financial management by a nationally recognized institute Achievement: 100 Data Source: ARIS M&E systems, procurement records, audit training and other audit records, BFM records, and local government records
